title: BCCI Ombudsman disqualifies KSCA secretary after completing maximum term
summary: Justice Arun Mishra (rtd), the ombudsman, in an order dated June 24, stated that Menon's tenure ended on Dec 16, 2025, nine days after he assumed charge following the elections held on December 7.
